prompt_text:
TRUE chunky pixel art animation Strip only. Four idle Frames of the SAME stout fantasy DWARF MINER, facing RIGHT, in one horizontal row.

Each Frame is an exact 16×24 logical grid rendered large as crisp square Cells. Four Frames, two full magenta #FF00FF logical gutter Cells between Frames, flat magenta keyed background, no labels, margins, extra rows, anti-aliasing, blur, gradients, or dithering.

Canonical dwarf: very short and broad; large rust-brown beard; oversized rounded BLUE metal helmet with a centered amber lamp; one black eye Cell when exposed, no white sclera; GREEN work tunic; dark leather belt with small amber buckle; thick gloves; broad brown boots; compact heavy pickaxe resting behind the right shoulder. Strong head/torso/boot mass and readable beard silhouette. The character must remain the same proportions and construction in every Frame.

Warm rugged storybook pixel art. Selective warm-dark outline. Neutral upper-left local highlight. Use only colors from assets/palettes/first-room.json and never use transport magenta on the subject.

Motion: subtle beard and torso breathing only. Boots remain planted on the bottom row. Frame 3 closes naturally into Frame 0. Preserve eye, helmet/lamp, beard, tunic, belt/buckle, gloves, boots, and pickaxe identity in every exposed pose.

Intended read: iconic working dwarf, compact and sturdy rather than tall human; immediately readable at native 16×24 scale.
